metadata.notes: The current DSH parser maps llm/retry records. The 2026-09-20 staged live candidate has three durable SERVER retries but only ready -> working -> ready, so it misses the required retry error window and remains known failing at 3/5 phases.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: bug
driver_capability: ready

The current DSH parser maps `llm/retry` to a retrying SessionError. The earlier claim that the parser skips llm/retry is no longer true.

The staged live candidate at `.claude/worktrees/1980-dsh-metrics-and-eta/.build/refresh/deepseek-harness/2-22_provider-overloaded-retry-20260920T200155` has three durable `llm/retry` records with `failure.code=SERVER`, at transcript sequences 16, 20, and 23. Its staged replay report records only ready -> working -> ready. It has no error transition between the first retry and the completed turn/end. The command `zstdcat <staging>/replaydata/agents/deepseek-harness/scenarios/2-22_provider-overloaded-retry/transcript.jsonl.zstd | jq -c 'select(.type == "llm/retry" or .type == "llm/retry-started" or .type == "turn/end")'` derives the retry rows.

`go run ./tools/onboarding-factory/cmd/of verify -agent deepseek-harness -scenario provider-overloaded-retry -json` reports 3/5 actual lifecycle phases: session_birth, pid_bind, and turn_start pass; retry_window and recovered fail because no error event exists. Its top-level pass fields remain true only because the spec marks the cell known failing. The missing error state justifies the daemon bug classification. It does not justify the obsolete parser-skip explanation.

The driver and mock are ready. Do not mark the cell observed until a current-code live recording shows the full error window and recovery.
caveats: The staged candidate is diagnostic evidence, not an observed fixture. It ran with git HEAD 28ce9c850 and has three retry records but no error transition.
The verifier must report actual phase results. known_failing can make top-level pass fields true while retry_window and recovered are false.
The mock must serve three counted HTTP 529 responses and then one successful completion. The transcript assertions require exactly three SERVER retries and one completed turn/end.
The retry parser handler exists, but the state path from a parsed retrying SessionError to an error transition still needs current-code live proof.
The recording must isolate title-generation traffic from counted primary requests and use a fresh run cwd and transcript marker.

sources.note: Installed 0.1.5-rc.2 package contract: default normal mode retries RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT, and EMPTY_RESPONSE up to five times, and each scheduled attempt reaches the durable session log before backoff.
The shipped backoff function appends llm/retry before its cancellable delay and llm/retry-started before returning retry to the agent loop.
The shipped pi-ai adapter classifies error text containing 429 or rate-limit as RATE_LIMIT and text containing any 5xx status as SERVER. Both codes are retryable under the default policy.
Measured DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 trace: lines 18-31 contain five durable llm/retry and llm/retry-started pairs with retry numbers 1-5 and increasing delayMs values before the terminal failed boundary.
Concrete daemon result for the measured retry trace: ready->working at sequence 255, no error during the five scheduled retries, then working->error only at sequence 420 after terminal turn_done.

Current recordHandlers maps llm/retry to a retrying SessionError and llm/retry-started to a retry-started event. The staged candidate still lacks an error state, so this source fact does not settle the end-to-end state path.
SessionError already represents retrying failures with attempt, maximum-attempt, retry-delay, class, and message fields; ClearedByTurnBoundary clears ErrorPhaseRetrying on the eventual turn_done.
ErrorPhaseRetrying is the domain shape for holding a session red for the whole retry window rather than flickering per attempt.
Declares and implements send, wait_turn, sleep, and exit_clean. It applies the recipe model, base URL, context window, permission mode, and API key through a temporary provider patch.

Commit 61cda4ff3 supplies the shared POST /v1/chat/completions mock. It supports fail-N-then-recover behavior, SSE success with usage, a case-insensitive ignored-request filter, and distinct #0 versus counted request logs.

go test ./tools/onboarding-factory/recording/mock-openai-error/... -race -count=1 passed. The tests cover failure then recovery and prove that title requests return success without incrementing the primary counter.
The installed 0.1.5-rc.2 title package starts its stable system prompt with Create a concise title for an AI coding-assistant session, which matches the mock's case-insensitive filter.

assessment.historical_body: Historical diagnosis: before the retry parser handler was added, llm/retry was skipped. That diagnosis explains older recordings but does not describe the current parser.

preconditions: dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 is installed and on PATH
the community TUI profile is installed under ~/.dsh/profiles/tui
port 18805 is free on 127.0.0.1 at record time
irrlichd is recording the deepseek-harness adapter
setup: run-cell.sh builds and launches tools/onboarding-factory/recording/mock-openai-error on 127.0.0.1:18805 before the driver starts

the mock ignores the DSH title-generation request for failure counting, fails the first three counted primary POST /v1/chat/completions requests with HTTP 529 overloaded_error, and succeeds on the fourth with an ok completion and non-zero usage

the interactive driver creates a fresh cwd and pre-launch marker, exports the configured non-empty API key through LMSTUDIO_API_KEY, applies a temporary OpenAI-compatible provider patch with base URL http://127.0.0.1:18805/v1, and launches dsh --profile tui in tmux
the driver resolves only the post-marker compressed transcript whose session header has the fresh cwd

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok

verify: the same DSH session follows ready -> working -> error -> ready and never enters waiting
the durable transcript contains exactly three llm/retry records with failure.code SERVER before one completed turn/end
the session enters error once and stays there across the complete retry window
the completed turn clears the retrying error and leaves the session ready before exit_clean
the mock log contains four counted primary request lines (#1 through #4); title traffic is logged as #0 and does not consume the failure counter
the live observation vector reports non-zero tokens and zero known cost; record fills the exact model from the recording
recipe.scope_note: Uses the muse sibling's five-second post-turn sleep, the longest committed sibling delay. The claudecode sibling has no sleep, but DSH writes compressed frames and the hold keeps recovery observable before exit_clean. The 180-second timeout matches both committed sibling recipes and exceeds the default three-retry backoff window by a wide margin.
